text:
mira: Heads-up — iterating on the per-endpoint KPI card. Seeing p99 really jumpy for a subset of routes. Thinking we need traffic smoothing + attribution to kernel vs KV-hit.
kevin: Which routes/time window? Can you paste an example trace or metric snippet?
mira: Route=chat-complete (prod-us). p99 jumped from ~220ms -> ~560ms at 03:12 UTC while throughput stayed flat. sample_count for that minute was only ~40.
anna: Small sample counts will make p99 noisy. We should show a sample_count badge on the card and maybe mute alerts below a threshold.
sam: Also check batch size distribution — a single large sequence can skew p99. Proposal: surface p50/p95/p99 plus median batch_size and kv_hit_rate on the card.
perf-bot: Profiling snapshot uploaded: s3://perf/artifacts/2170001234/trace.html. Early look: KV miss rate jumped and the runtime fell back to the slower kernel path (fp16->int8 fallback) for a few minutes.
kevin: For the dashboard metric split I propose adding kernel and kv_hit labels. Example PromQL for the p99 panel:
```promql
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(token_latency_bucket[1m])) by (le, route, kernel, kv_hit))
```
Then we can stack by kernel / kv_hit to see contribution.
anna: UI idea: small overlay on the KPI card with three badges: sample_count, median_batch_size, kv_hit_pct. Hover opens the latest trace link.
jordan: Also recommend smoothing weights for the UI so a one-minute blip with low samples doesn't dominate. Suggest exponential decay with 5m half-life (or a configurable window).
mira: Good. Can we also add an 'attributed p99' view that breaks p99 into compute vs kv_wait vs tokenize so product teams can quickly see root cause? Mockup would help.
sam: I'll mock a wireframe and produce the derived SQL for the card backend. Example derived query: 
```sql
SELECT route, percentile(99, latency) AS p99, quantile(0.5, batch_size) AS median_batch, sum(CASE WHEN kv_miss THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float/count(*) AS kv_miss_rate
FROM telemetry
WHERE ts > now()-interval '1 hour'
GROUP BY route
```
perf-bot: Note: we have sampling bias in traces (we currently store full traces for >500ms). Recommend adding a uniform reservoir (1/100) to retain low-latency examples for attribution.
mira: Action items: @sam — wireframe + SQL; @kevin — add promql split and update alert to check sample_count; @anna — update card UX to include badges + hover; @jordan — prototype smoothing weights; I'll own follow-up and a canary for the UI change.
deploy-bot: Canary created: deploy/console-kpi-overlay/sha@abcdef -> canary=10%.
anna: Thanks, will iterate on copy and link behavior (trace should open in new tab + annotated steps).
mira: Tagging eng-runtime to watch kernel fallback + kv_hit metrics during the canary — please flag if you see correlated p99 regressions.
